combatIntentHints.label: Seal the shade
combatIntentHints.reason: The named shade is testing whether the Bulwark will take companion pressure first.

combatIntentHints.label: Trim the pack
combatIntentHints.reason: Small enemies left alive become healer pressure.

combatIntentHints.label: Hold Frontline
combatIntentHints.reason: The heavy hit should stay on the Bulwark.

combatIntentHints.label: Take the mark
combatIntentHints.reason: Shield Oath keeps the mark from biting the companion lane.

combatIntentHints.label: Swap to adds
combatIntentHints.reason: Adds left alive become healer pressure.

combatIntentHints.label: Use the bell
combatIntentHints.reason: The Road-Seal Bell weakens the next Final Toll.

combatIntentHints.label: Hold the lane
combatIntentHints.reason: The hook should catch your shield before it reaches the companion lane.

combatIntentHints.label: Shift safely
combatIntentHints.reason: The room is teaching lane movement before the final boss punishes timing.

combatIntentHints.label: Stabilize or pressure
combatIntentHints.reason: The wax channel softens the wrong-way bell cast.

combatIntentHints.label: Read the wax
combatIntentHints.reason: The room object matters before the caster punishes the party.

objectLessons.untouched: The wax channel has not been stabilized.
objectLessons.noticed: The wax channel has been noticed. Use `inspect wax seal channel` to stabilize it.
objectLessons.stabilized: The wax channel is stabilized. Bell casts hit softer, and the cache can include a Bell Sliver.

objectLessons.untouched: The Road-Seal Bell is waiting for Road-Seal Pulse.
objectLessons.noticed: When the Warden shows Road-Seal Pulse, use `use road-seal bell` before Final Toll.
objectLessons.stabilized: The Road-Seal Bell has answered this pulse. Guard the next Final Toll.

sourceNote: Gameplay hints are local tutorial support derived from First Road room lessons, encounters, and no-ghost-loot law.
